batches.description: Controlled nutrient fed-batch run with optimal stationary viability.
Biological replicate demonstrating natural run-to-run variation.
High glucose feeding creating toxic lactate accumulation (> 3.5 g/L) and accelerated decline.
High density cell culture (>20e6 cells/mL) with tight metabolite control.

disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA — NOT EXPERIMENTAL DATA. Calibrated with biophysical Monod and metabolic inhibition kinetics for competition validation. Never present synthetic data as experimental wet-lab data.
